Commentary.Commentary: Niall O'Brien says that they have a decent score on the board as the wicket is slow. Adds they have good spinners in their side. Reckons they have to bowl and field well. Ends by saying that they have a great bunch of lads and will look to give everything it takes on the field.

Afghanistan were terrific with the ball and in the field. Some good, tight bowling throughout was backed up by athletic fielding. Never gave away any loose balls and piled on the pressure. Rashid Khan led the charge with a 3-fer while Dawlat Zadran got 2 and Mohammad Nabi bagged 1. A target of 210 is something that the Afghans would fancy. A World Cup spot is up for grabs. Should be a good second half. Join us in a while for all the action.

Not exactly the total Ireland would have liked on the board, but from the position in which they were, they'd surely take this. They got off to a steady start courtesy their openers, and were going on steady with Paul Stirling and Niall O'Brien knitting a solid stand. But when you pace things on the slower side, you must accelerate later. Stirling was the key to that, but he got out after making a fifty. The Irish would have finished with a lower score, but Kevin O'Brien used his experience and ensured his side at least got past 200.
Short ball into the body, Andy McBrine rocks back and pulls it through square leg for a single. IRELAND FINISH ON 209/7!

Safe! Good running between the wickets. McBrine knocks this to long on and quickly calls for the second. McCarthy reacts, comes back and slides his bat in when the bails are taken off. It goes upstairs and replays show that he's safe.
A run out appeal against McCarthy is referred upstairs.
FOUR! All handy runs for Ireland! Short ball on off, McBrine gets a big top edge on his pull and it goes over the keeper's head. Away to the fence and that'll be a boundary.
Takes the pace off this again, on middle and off and shorter in length, McBrine swings hard and misses completely.
Barry McCarthy will bat now.
OUT! Taken! Slower short ball outside off, Wilson is a bit early into the shot, so slaps it high towards backward point. Najibullah backpedals and takes a well-judged catch.
Short ball on middle and leg, McBrine is hurried into the pull shot and as a result, gets a top edge over backward square leg where the ball falls safely. One run taken.
Good running between the wickets. Pitches it on middle, Wilson moves inside the line and works it away on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Bit wide outside off, it's hit through backward point for a run.
Loopy and full outside off, goes for the reverse sweep but misses it completely.
Full but straighter in line, swept through backward square leg for two.
Googly tossed around off, spins away and beats the outside edge of McBrine's bat as he comes forward to defend.
Andy McBrine next in.

OUT! Bowled'em! Cleaned him up and who else, Rashid Khan. He bowls it quick around the off stump line, Kevin tries to slog sweep it but fails to make any connection. That is 99th wicket for him. Just one away from the milestone. Can he do so?
Rashid Khan comes back on.
Short delivery banged in towards the batsman. He fends it awkwardly and the ball runs towards the left of the stumps. They sneak in a single.
Slower delivery, back of a length outside off stump. Kevin fails to put bat to it.
Lofted aerially towards covers. One run taken.
Short delivery, pulled in control towards square leg for a run.
FOUR! Dawlat drifts on to Kevin's pads and he works it fine. The ball runs to the fine leg region for a boundary. Kevin is looking to cut loose.
SIX! What a shot! They need more hits like this. Short delivery and Kevin pulls it over the square leg region for a maximum.
Leading edge runs to the short third man region. End of a tidy spell, 10-0-31-0.
Googly by Mujeeb from outside the off stump. Wilson tries to flick it but misses.
A loss full toss, played to long on for a single.
Tossed up delivery around the leg stump line, swept to square leg. One run taken.
Short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper cover for an easy single.
Quicker delivery, driven back to bowler.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman comes back into the attack.
Short delivery, pulled to mid-wicket for a brace.
Wide! Short delivery way above the batsman's head, the umpire signals it a wide. Free Hit continues.
Ireland will have to make use of these last overs to get to a total of more than 200.
Free Hit on its way...

Short delivery banged in towards the batsman, Wilson tries to pull it away. But the leading edge goes straight to Gulbadin Naib at fine leg, he takes an easy catch. But to the bowler's dismay he oversteps.
Hold on, Wilson has been caught out but the umpires want to check the front foot.
Slower bouncer outside the off stump channel by Dawlat. Wilson slaps it to point.
Play and a miss. Another short delivery by Dawlat. Wilson tries to pull it away but fails to make any connection.
Short delivery banged in towards the batsman. Kevin pulls it to fine leg. One run taken.
Full delivery, angling in towards the batsman. Wilson plays it to long on for a single.
Short delivery outside off stump, guided to third man. One run taken.
Dawlat Zadran comes back into the attack.
Flatter delviery around the off stump line, punched to sweeper cover for an easy single.
Swept to square leg for a single.
Missed chance. A full toss which had to be put away is played to long on for just a single.
FOUR! A rare one as to how the game has been going. Too full this time by Rashid and Kevin sweeps it past the square leg region for a boundary.
Googly from around the off stump channel, blocked away.
Google played with soft hands to square leg and good running by the batsmen allow them to come back for a couple.
Quicker delivery outside off stump, driven hard to covers. A misfield allows them to take a single.
Tossed up delivery around the off stump channel, defended off the front foot.
Floated delivery coming in towards the batsman, defended off the back foot by Kevin.
Tossed up delivery around the off stump channel, swept to short fine leg for a run.
Cut to point for a single.
The ball finds the outside edge of the bat and runs to the third man area. Two runs taken.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman comes back on.
Loud appeal but turned down by the umpire. Googly pitched outside the off stump channel. Wilson tries to defend it but gets hit on his pads. Replays show that the impact was outside off stump.
Flatter delivery outside the off stump line, punched to covers.
Almost played on. Googly once again and the batsman fails tor read. Wilson somehow manages to fend it away.
Short and wide outside off stump, cut to sweeper cover. One run taken. These wont harm the Afghanistan team.
Full and quick this time by Rashid, defended off the front foot.
Quick and on the shorter side outside off stump, cut hard to point.
Played with soft hands towards off side for a single.
FOUR! Full and down the leg side, Kevin O'Brien paddle sweeps it past the fine leg region for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off stump, slapped to sweeper cover. One run taken.
Floated delivery driven down the ground for a single.
Tossed up delivery outside off stump, pushed to point for a run.
Punched off the back foot to covers for a single.
Gary Wilson comes to bat

OUT! Early drop by Nabi does not cost much and Singh walks back to the pavilion. Another googly from outside off, Singh comes behind the line of the ball and tries to flick it away. The ball takes the edge and goes to the keeper. Shahzad goes to his left and collects it well.
Another googly by Rashid. He bowls it around the off stump channel, Singh tries to defend it but gets hit on his pads.
FOUR! Quick and short by Rashid. Singh opens the face of the bat and runs it down to the third man fence.
Googly from outside the off stump channel. Singh tries to defend it but gets struck high on his pads.
Tossed up delivery driven to covers for a couple of runs.

DROPPED! That was straight forward and Nabi just had to collect it. Tossed up delivery outside the off stump, Singh pushes at it. The ball finds the outside edge to first slip. Nabi gets his hands to it but fails to pouch it.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. 5 fielders are allowed outside the circle.
Quicker delivery, full on the leg stump. Played to long on for a run.
Worked off his hips to square leg for a run.
Tossed up delivery, driven back to the bowler.
Quicker delivery outside off stump, punched to covers for a single.
Short and wide outside off stump, punched to point.
Tossed up delivery, played to mid-wicket.
Nabi comes into the attack.
Full delivery, played with soft hands to long on. Singh will keep the strike for next over with a single.
Wide! Rashid drifts a quicker delivery down the leg side. The umpire signals it a wide.
Quicker ball played to mid-wicket.
Tossed up delivery turning away from the batsman, outside the off stump channel. Singh tries to sweep it but gets hit on his pads.
Quick and full on the leg stump line, worked to long on. One run taken.
Tossed up delivery, played to square leg for a run.
Quicker and full around the off stump line, played to mid-wicket.
Rashid Khan comes back into the attack.
Short delivery, pulled aerially towards fine leg for a single.
The umpire shakes his head. Full delivery drifting down the leg side. Singh misses the flick as it hits his pads and goes to the keeper. They go up for the appeal but the umpire is unmoved.
Quick delivery on a back of a length outside the off stump channel, guided to third man. One run taken.
Slower delivery on a back of a length around the off stump line, defended back to the bowler.
Back of a length delivery outside off stump, played to point.
Short delivery banged in towards the batsman, played to square leg for a run.
Tossed up delivery, played to mid-wicket. Just 2 runs off the over.
Cut to point with ease for a single.
Singh tries to work it away to the leg side, dancing down the track. The ball hits him on the pads and rolls to point. No run taken.
Beaten! This was quick and on the shorter side outside off stump. Singh tries to work it away but fails as the ball straightens after pitching.
Floated delivery outside off stump. Singh tires to sweep it but gets hit on his pads. The impact was outside off stump.
Tossed up delivery outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside the off stump, played to point.
Punched off the back foot to covers for a run.
Kevin O'Brien walks in next.
Drinks are on the field.

OUT! The change of bowling has done the trick yet another time. Full outside off, which is asking to be put away. Niall drives it in air towards covers. Samiullah Shenwari takes an easy catch. Niall goes back in the hut after a decent start.
Full delivery outside the off stump, played with soft hands towards covers. One run taken.
Short delivery outside off stump, cut to the right of the point fielder. An easy single taken.
Back of a length delivery outside off stump, played to point.
Dawlat Zadran comes back on.
Shorter in length this time, punched to covers for a single.
Beaten. This one turned away from the batsman. He tries to defend it off the back foot but fails to make any connection.
Swept to square leg for a single.
Flighted delivery around off stump, Niall sweeps it through the square leg region. Dawlat does well with his foot to save a run for his side in the deep. Three runs taken.
Tossed up delivery outside off stump, worked to point.
Flatter delivery, defended off the back foot.
Quick and full this time by Nabi. Driven hard to mid on.
Floated delivery flicked to square leg.
Tossed up delivery around the off stump channel, played wide of point for a run.
Quicker delivery pushed to covers.
Tossed up delivery outside the off stump. Niall tries to drive it but finds the bottom edge to it. The ball runs back to the bowler.
Full and wide outside off stump, blocked by the batsman.
Floated delivery, Singh does well to block it away.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the front foot.
Googly from outside the off stump. Singh tries to defend it off the front foot but gets hit on his pads. It was struck outside the off stump line.
Punched off the back foot to covers for a run.
Simi Singh next in to bat.

OUT! Mujeeb was brought on to provide a wicket and he has done it. Not in the way he would have hoped for, but they would be happy to see Stirling's back. Tossed up delivery around the off stump line, Niall reverse sweeps it to point. There was a yes and no in between the batsmen whether take a run or decide against it. Stirling was halfway down the wicket before turning around. Najibullah Zadran picks up the ball and gives it to Mujeeb at non-striker's end. He took the bails off in flash. The replays show Stirling is just short. A big blow for Ireland.
Run out appeal against Paul Stirling is referred upstairs.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman into the attack now.
Tossed up delivery,  around the off stump line, defended off the back foot.
Tossed up delivery, pushed to covers. Good comeback by Nabi after being hit for a boundary and a maximum.
Stirling opens the face of the bat and works it to point.
Sensible cricket! Worked it off his hips to square leg for a single.
FOUR! A maximum followed up by a boundary. Floated delivery, full outside off stump. Niall slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
SIX! That's a good strike. Tossed up delivery around the middle stump line. Niall comes charging down and lofts it over long on for a maximum.
Wide! Nabi drags it full down the leg side, umpire signals it a wide.
Beaten! Beautifully bowled. Gave it some air as he lands it on a driving length outside the off stump line. Niall tries to drive it but fails to make a connection with the bat.
Quicker and full this time, played off the front foot. Rashid has been bowling beautifully.
Another googly, played with soft hands to point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Beaten. Another googly and Niall tries to defend it but fails to put bat to it.
They are not able to read him. Yet another googly, Stirling tries to defend it but the ball finds the inside edge. It runs to square leg for a run.
Googly hit high on his pads and also going down the leg side. Stirling didn't pick it up.
Loopy delivery around the off stump line, on the shorter side, the batsman defends it off the back foot.
Full delivery, darted in towards the batsman's legs. Blocked to mid-wicket.
Quicker delivery outside off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! That's really well played. Tossed up delivery outside off stump, Niall reverse sweeps it over the short third man region for a boundary.
Tossed up delivery, around the off stump channel. Stirling comes dancing down and plays it to long on for a run.
Quick and full on the stumps, defended off the front foot.
Tossed up delivery outside off stump, driven to covers for a run.
Short delivery around the off stump line, punched to long off for a single.
Looped up delivery outside off stump, driven to long on for a single.
Tossed up delivery driven to long on. One run taken.
Full and on the leg stump this time. He works it to mid-wicket.
Played to backward square leg for an easy run.
Tossed up delivery, pushed to covers for a quick single. This brings up 16th ODI fifty for him. He needs to carry on for his side.
Struck hard to sweeper cover for a single.
Quicker delivery on the stumps, blocked away.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Niall goes for the sweep but manages to find the inside edge to it. The ball runs to fine leg for a boundary.
Full and quick delivery, defended off the front foot.
Short delivery outside off, pushed to cover-point for a run.
Short delivery, cut to point for a single.
Nabi comes back into the attack.
Tossed up delivery, pushed to mid-wicket.
SIX! That was huge! This was the first false delivery by him, he bowled it short. Stirling rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Tossed up delivery around the off stump channel, Stirling tries to sweep it but manages to bottom edge it.
Gives himself some room to cut it hard but gets an inside edge on to his pads.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Niall is not able to pick this young man. He is turning it both ways. The batsman does well to get an inside edge onto his pads.
Fuller and googly this time by Rashid. The batsman tries to defend it but gets beaten.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the front foot.

FOUR! Sloppy by the captain. He tries to pick it up with one hand but ends up giving some free runs to the opposition. Tossed up delivery driven down the ground and Niall O'Brien will register a boundary against his name.
Tossed up delivery around the leg stump channel, pushed uppishly to mid-wicket.
Quick and full outside off stump, defended well off the front foot.
Flighted delivery, defended off the front foot.

Loud LBW shout but nothing from the umpire. Tossed up delivery around the middle stump line, turning away from the batsman. Stirling comes charging down the track and tries to flick it but gets hit on the pads. The ball had to travel a lot of distance, which is why the umpire turned it down.
Quicker and coming in towards the batsman. Stirling blocks it.
Floated ball, defended off the front foot.
Flighted delivery around the leg stump line, played to mid-wicket.
Tossed up delivery on leg, worked to square leg for an easy single.
Worked down the leg side to get off the mark with a single. A successful over for the Afghan team. Just a run and a wicket off it.
Niall O'Brien comes in to bat.

OUT! He was looking in trouble against the leggie and now has to have a long walk back to the pavilion. He did set him up beautifully with three googlies and followed this with a straighter one. Short and wide outside off stump, Balbirnie tries to punch it away but gets the outside edge. Shahzad collects it with ease. Rashid Khan steps up when his team needs him.
Tossed up delivery outside off stump, driven to covers.
That was quick on the stumps, the batsman does well to block it.
Almost had his man. Another googly this time, quick and a bit short, Balbirnie does well to bring his bat down in time.
The batsman tries to sweep this googly out of trouble. The ball takes the inside edge and hits him on his boots.
Quicker delivery on the leg stump, played to mid-wicket for a run.
That was a good sweep. Flighted delivery around the off stump channel, swept with ease to deep mid-wicket. Two runs taken.
Tossed up delivery driven to covers.
Stirling seems to be in some trouble. Physio is out in the middle to have a look.
Quick and full on the middle stump line. Stirling tries to sweep it but gets a bottom edge on it. The ball runs to mid-wicket for a run.
The bowler got turn on this one. Tossed up delivery around the off stump line, Stirling tries to defend it but gets the outside edge. The ball runs to third man region and they take a couple.
Tossed up delivery, jabbed to covers for a run.
Pushed to covers for an easy single.
Close to the outside edge, but nothing from the umpire. Short and wide outside off, Balbirnie tries to cut it but fails.
Googly had almost done the trick. Quick and full around the off stump line, Balbirnie tries to drive it but finds the inside edge of the bat. The ball runs to the leg side for no run.
Tossed up delivery, driven to long off for a run.
Short delivery outside off stump, punched to covers.
Starts by bowling it quick and short on the stumps. Pushed to mid-wicket for a single.
Rashid Khan comes into the attack. A wicket coming up?
Stirling charges down the track and defends it off the front foot.
In the air.... but safe. Tossed up delivery in the driving length area. Stirling pushes hard at it. The ball lobs towards covers but just drops in front of the fielder.
A push off the back foot to covers for a run.
Tossed up delivery around the leg stump line, worked to mid-wicket.
Short and wide delivery slapped to cover-point for a run.
Tossed up delivery around off stump, played to covers.
Length delivery outside off stump, the ball takes the outside edge as Stirling tries to drive. One run taken as the ball runs to third man.
Stirling taps it to point and wants a quick single but his partner decides against it.
Full length delivery outside off, driven to mid off for a quick run.
Good length delivery around the off stump line, played with ease to the point region.
Back of a length delivery outside off stump, cut to point.
Slower delivery on a back of a length outside off, Stirling drives it to covers. The fielder misfields and the ball runs to sweeper cover. They take a single.
Loud shout for an lbw, it's turned down. Pretty close, that. Tossed up on leg, it spins towards off and catches Balbirnie low on the front pad when he misses his sweep shot.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Swept away on the leg side. No run taken.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Balbirnie pushes it into the covers for no run.
Takes a nice, big stride forward and drives it through mid off for a single.
Uses his feet to get to the pitch, but can't make connection with the bat. Off the pads it falls besides him.
Drinks are on the field.
Length delivery, pushed to covers.
That was close to the edge! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. The batsman tries to cut it but fails to put bat to it.
Another short delivery banged in towards the batsman, pulled to square leg for a single.
Short delivery wide outside off, Stirling pulls it over mid-wicket. Due to the wet outfield, the ball does not reach the boundary but the batsmen pick up a couple.
Length ball, driven past covers for a single.
Full delivery outside the off stump line, driven to covers. One run taken.
Gulbadin Naib will have a change of ends.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the front foot.
Flighted delivery short outside the off stump, punched to covers.
Short delivery outside off, cut to point.
Floated delivery full outside the off stump, driven hard to covers.
Flighted delivery which is pushed to cover-point.
Tossed up delivery outside the off stump line, Balbirnie lets it go to the keeper.
Sharafuddin Ashraf comes into the attack.
Flighted delivery around the middle stump line, driven to long on. One run taken. A successful over for Afghanistan.
Back foot punch to the mid-wicket region.
Tossed up delivery outside off stump, played towards point for another run.
Nudged to backward point for a single.
Andrew Balbirnie comes into bat.

OUT! The skipper picked out the fielder perfectly. Tossed up delivery around the leg stump line. Porterfield tries to flick it but could not keep it down. The ball goes to mid-wicket where Rahmat Shah pouches it comfortably. End to a 53-run stand and it's Nabi who provides the Afghan team with the breakthrough.
Full delivery darted in full outside off stump. The batsman tries to reverse sweep it but fails to put bat to it.
Back of a length delivery angling towards the batsman. Porterfield runs it down with ease to third man for a single.
Good shot! Length delivery driven to long on for a run.
Back of a length around the off stump line. Stirling shuffles a bit and plays it back to the bowler.
Back of a length delivery, angling in towards the batsman. Played to mid-wicket.
Full delivery in the middle stump line, driven back to the bowler.
Slower one, full and outside off. Stirling drives it to mid on.
Worked up mid-wicket for an easy single.
Flighted delivery outside off stump, Stirling drives it hard to covers. The fielder does well to make a diving save.
Tossed up delivery dragged short, worked to fine leg for a run. This brings up the fifty partnership. They have done it with ease.
Flighted delivery around the off stump channel, played with soft hands.
Swept along the ground to square leg for a run.
Tossed up delivery, driven straight back.
Length delivery angling in towards the batsman. Porterfield pushes it to covers.
Back of a length delivery outside off stump, defended off the back foot.
Another edge which runs down to the third man region for a single.
Play and a miss. Back of a length delivery outside off stump, Stirling tries to slap it but misses.
Full length delivery outside the off stump line. Porterfield gets the outside edge and the ball runs to the third man area. The batsmen change ends.
Full length delivery played with ease to wide of mid on. One run taken.
Punched to covers to end the over with a dot ball. 5 runs came off Nabi's first over.
FOUR! Whacked away! Nabi bowls it quick and short outside off. Porterfield pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Nabi floats it around the off stump line, Porterfield defends it from within the crease.
Flighted delivery, defended off the front foot.
Played with soft hands to point for a quick single.
Starts by tossing it up around the off stump. Stirling comes charging down and defends it off the front foot.
Mohammad Nabi comes into the attack.
Straighter delivery in the middle stump line, Porterfield defends it off the front foot. Good first over by Naib.
Defended off the back foot to point region.
Good length delivery outside off stump, played to the point region.
Back of a length delivery outside off stump, punched to sweeper cover for a brace.
The batsman moves across to the off side and tries to flick it off his hips. The ball hits him on his thigh pad and rolls to leg side. They sneak in a leg bye.
Starts by dragging it down the leg side. Stirling tries to clip it but gets hit on the pads and goes to the keeper. The keeper goes up for the appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Gulbadin Naib comes into the attack.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. 4 fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.

That was close, very close! The ball turned towards the batsman as he tried to defend it off the front foot. It strikes him on the pads. To the naked eye it looked out but the umpire had his own views on it. 37-0 after 10 overs.
Floated ball towards the batsman, Porterfield gets forward and defends it.
Flighted delivery, played to mid-wicket.

That came back in sharply and Porterfield gets his bat down in time. Tossed up delivery around the off stump line, turning in towards the batsman. The batsman was caught in two minds as to what to do but manages to defend it away.
Swept through the square leg region for a single.
Short and wide outside off stump. Stirling tries to cut but fails to put bat to it.
Full delivery driven straight back for a single.

FOUR! Poor by the bowler. He brought the third man up inside the circle for this delivery and bowled it down the wrong channel. Back of a length delivery outside off stump, not what his captain wanted him to bowl. Stirling stands tall and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Tapped to mid off for a quick single.
Good length delivery outside off stump, Porterfield tries to drive it but the ball gets past the outside edge.

Stirling comes down the track and tries to flick it off his hips but misses the ball completely. The ball strikes him high on his pads and runs to the fine leg region. The batsmen change ends. The replays show that height was the issue.
FOUR! Well struck by the batsman. Length delivery around the middle stump line, lifted over mid-wicket for a boundary. Good positive start by Ireland.
Tossed up this time on the shorter side. Defended off the back foot.
A low full toss outside off stump, reverse swept to point.
Porterfield misses the googly. He tries to defend the ball but gets beaten.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the front foot.
That was full and quick, coming towards the batsman. Porterfield misses it and gets struck on his pads. The ball was drifting down the leg side.
Wide! The bowler drags it full down the leg side. The batsman tries to sweep it but misses it. The umpires signals it a wide.
Straight delivery outside off stump, defended to point.
Quick running by the batsmen. Porterfield plays at a back of a length delivery with soft hands. The ball rolls near the pitch area. One run taken.
Short delivery banged in outside the off stump line, played to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Good length delivery, seaming in towards the batsman. Stirling defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery around the off stump line, defended off the front foot.
Full delivery outside off stump, driven hard but straight to the fielder at covers.
Stirling comes late at the delivery. He tries to drive a full delivery but the ball takes the inside half of the bat and runs to mid-wicket.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the front foot.

Yet another bad ball and Porterfield makes full use of it. He goes back and pulls it towards mid-wicket for a brace. Due to the rain, the outfield is quite slow which is why it is restricted to just a couple of runs. Any other day it was a definite boundary.
FOUR! Sloppy fielding at covers cost the team a boundary. Short delivery outside off stump, Porterfield punches it past covers for a boundary.
Flighted delivery, a tad short in the middle stump line. The batsman defends it off the back foot.
Tossed up delivery outside off stump. Porterfield tries to play a reverse sweep but fails to make any connection.
The ball takes the outside edge and runs to short third man. One run taken.
That was a beauty! The bowler lands it on a driving length around the off stump line, seaming away from the batsman. The skipper tries to play at it but gets beaten.
Back of a length delivery outside off stump, Stirling runs it to third man for a single.
Stirling comes forward and defends it to covers.
Length delivery defended off the front foot.

Big appeal, but the umpire does not move an inch. The team in Blue were confident about it. Dawlat lands it on a back of a length outside the off stump line and the ball seamed in a bit. Stirling tries to pull it but he seems to have missed. No harm done.
Back of a length delivery around the off stump line, defended from within the crease.
Well bowled! The ball moved away after pitching. The batsman tried to play at it but gets beaten. The Afghan team goes up but the umpire is unmoved.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the front foot.
The bowler drifts a full ball down the leg side. Stirling tries to sweep it but gets hit low on his pads. The ball runs to short fine leg. One run taken.
Flighted delivery outside off stump, Stirling plays a square drive towards the point region. The fielder does well to make a diving save.
Tossed up delivery on the middle stump line, played with ease to mid-wicket.
Clipped to square leg for a single.
Good length delivery in the middle stump line, defended off the front foot.
Good comeback by the bowler. He bowls a full length delivery outside off stump, Stirling drives it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Terrific shot! He picked the length up and got in the position early. Short delivery outside off stump, Stirling stood tall and pulled it through mid-wicket for the first boundary of many more to come.
Length ball outside off stump, defended off the front foot.
In the air.. but safe. Good length delivery outside off stump, Porterfield tries to push at it. The ball takes the outside edge and flies to the third man fielder for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off stump, defended off the back foot.
Floated delivery outside off stump, defended off the front foot.
The bowler drifts a tossed up delivery on the legs. Stirling clips it to square leg for a couple of runs.
Swept to the left of the short fine leg fielder for a brace.
Stirling comes forward and defends a flighted delivery off the front foot.
Flighted delivery outside off stump. Stirling tries to sweep at it but gets hit high on his forearm.
Tossed up delivery around the middle and leg stump line. Stirling sweeps it to the short fine leg fielder.
Wide! The bowler starts by drifting it down the leg side. The umpire signals it a wide.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman will start from other end.
Back of a length delivery, defended off the back foot. 2 runs off the first over.
Stirling gets off the mark with a single. Full delivery outside off stump, driven towards covers. The fielder does well to make a diving save but cannot stop the batsmen from taking a single.
First run for Ireland. Full delivery driven straight back to the bowler. Dawlat tries to stop it but is not able to do it cleanly. The ball deflects towards mid off and the batsmen steal a single.
Back of a length ball around the off stump line, seaming towards the batsman a little. The batsman tries to play at it but gets hit high on the thigh pad.
This one seamed away a little. The bowler pitches it around the 5th stump line and Porterfield lets it go with ease.
Good start by Dawlat. He runs in hard and lands it on a good length spot outside off stump. The batsman shoulders arms to it.

We are done and dusted with the national anthems of the respective teams. The umpires are out in the middle. Afghanistan team are in the huddle. William Porterfield and Paul Stirling will open the innings for Ireland. Dawlat Zadran will have the new ball in hand. Let's get underway. Decider!
Pitch report - There is some grass in the center of the wicket which will assist the fast bowlers early with some seam movement. The batsmen need to be watchful at the start of their innings.

Afghanistan playing XI - Mohammad Shahzad (WK), Gulbadin Naib, Rahmat Shah, Asghar Stanikzai (C), Samiullah Shenwari, Mohammad Nabi, Najibullah Zadran, Rashid Khan, Sharafuddin Ashraf, Dawlat Zadran, Mujeeb Ur Rahman.
Ireland playing XI - William Porterfield (C), Paul Stirling, Andrew Balbirnie, Niall O Brien (WK), Kevin O Brien, Simi Singh, Gary Wilson, Andy McBrine, Barry McCarthy, Boyd Rankin, Tim Murtagh.

Asghar Stanikzai, Afghanistan captain, says they are well assured of their bowlers to step up with the help of the wicket which has a bit of moisture on it. Reckons that he is only 75% it but for him the country is more important. Adds that they will enjoy this pressure game and give their best. Ends by saying that there is no change to their side.

William Porterfield, Ireland captain, says it is a used pitch. Admits they had a couple of days off and they have been preparing well. Mentions they will like to take it ball by ball and not look too far ahead. Informs They are unchanged from the last game.
Toss - Ireland win the toss and elect to bat first.

Hello and welcome to the Harare Sports Club, for the decider as to who will be the last team to book a seat for the World Cup 2019. Zimbabwe's defeat against UAE has made this dead rubber the most interesting match of this competition. The last match of the Super Sixes stage happens to be a clash between Ireland and Afghanistan. Both teams have had a bit of luck going their way but today they will have to pull up their socks and perform. Let's hope that the rain gods stay away from this encounter and we have a full 50-over clash. We are expecting it to be a match full of excitement.
